title: Automatic matching is enabled without a measured blind-validation precision gate or complete evaluation provenance

original_titles.title: Auto-accept enabled by default without the blind-validation gate
Auto-accept is live without the 99% precision validation gate
Evaluator version never recorded; no evaluations entity
Evaluation records lack engine version, ruleset hash and candidate set
Evaluator logic copy-pasted between evaluator.py and evaluator_level.py
matching.decide and decide_multi duplicate the scoring/threshold logic
Wide-span reports score full location match; span width never weighted (shotgun padding viable)
Level-2 multi-location match rule deviates from spec
No recorded-corpus determinism replay test in CI

problem: The evaluator automatically awards evidence points when a matcher returns accept_full. There is no persisted evaluation entity containing engine/matcher version, feature values, candidate set and decision provenance; the matching functions decide/decide_multi duplicate scoring logic. The audit also claims wide-span reports can obtain a full location score, which should be validated with a focused adversarial fixture.
impact: A matcher regression or threshold drift can create incorrect awards without a documented precision measurement or exact replay evidence. Duplicated matcher logic can diverge between single- and multi-location decisions.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Create a versioned evaluation record for every machine decision: matcher_version, ruleset hash, normalized input hash, candidate ids/version, feature vector, threshold, outcome, selected bug and timestamp.
Build a curated blind-validation corpus with positive, negative, ambiguous, multi-location, wide-span and adversarial shotgun reports. Keep authoring/validation sets separate.
Measure precision/recall by outcome and severity. Disable auto-accept unless the owner-approved precision threshold is met; route uncertain cases to human review.
Refactor decide and decide_multi around a shared scorer so candidate ranking, thresholds and span penalties are consistent and centrally testable.
Add deterministic replay tests that recompute decisions for the stored corpus under a pinned matcher version and assert exact output/ledger effects.

acceptance_criteria: Auto-accept is disabled unless a recorded blind validation report meets the agreed precision threshold.
Every decision is replayable from stored engine/ruleset/candidate metadata.
Single- and multi-location tests use the same scoring semantics.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: The PR CI passing 81 tests and E2E 46 checks does not prove matcher precision. A precision gate requires an independently labelled validation corpus.
